authority: read-only discovery; execution requires route + grant + runtime

skills.description: Create a candidate marketplace skill package with an agent, scripts, references, assets, and tests. Use when a marketplace needs a new skill. Does not register the candidate.
Delete a candidate skill package. Use when a candidate should be removed. Refuses a skill the catalog lists.
Retrieve a skill from the catalog, or from a candidate package. Use to read a skill. Does not register the candidate.
Update the description of a candidate skill package. Use when a candidate needs a new purpose. Does not change the catalog.
